lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੈਦੋ ਨ ਵਾਈ ਭੈਣੋ ਨ ਭਾਈ ਏਕੋ ਸਹਾਈ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: vaido na vaaee bhaino na bhaaee eko sahaaee raam he ||1||
lines.translation: The One Lord alone is our help and support; neither physician nor friend, nor sister nor brother can be this. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਜਿਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਮਲੋ ਧੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: keetaa jiso hovai paapaa(n) malo dhovai so simarahu paradhaan he ||2||
lines.translation: His actions alone come to pass; He washes off the filth of sins. Meditate in remembrance on that Supreme Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਵਾਸੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghate vaasee sarab nivaasee asathir jaa kaa thaan he ||3||
lines.translation: He abides in each and every heart, and dwells in all; His seat and place are eternal. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aavai na jaavai sa(n)ge samaavai pooran jaa kaa kaam he ||4||
lines.translation: He does not come or go, and He is always with us. His actions are perfect. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat janaa kaa raakhanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: He is the Savior and the Protector of His devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t jeevahi jap praan adhaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Saints live by meditating on God, the support of the breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੫॥੨॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran samarath suaamee naanak tis kurabaan he ||5||2||32||
lines.translation: The Almighty Lord and Master is the Cause of causes; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||5||2||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ko naam sadaa sukhadaaee ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is forever the Giver of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਹੂ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau simar ajaamal udhario ganikaa hoo gat paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on it, Ajaamal was saved, and Ganika the prostitute was emancipated. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚਾਲੀ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਧਿ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)chaalee kau raaj sabhaa mahi raam naam sudh aaee ||
lines.translation: Dropadi the princess of Panchaala remembered the Lord's Name in the royal court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦੂਖੁ ਹਰਿਓ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਪੈਜ ਬਢਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taa ko dookh hario karunaa mai apanee paij badhaaee ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord, the embodiment of mercy, removed her suffering; thus His own glory was increased. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਜਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਇਓ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਓ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jih nar jas kirapaa nidh gaaio taa kau bhaio sahaaee ||
lines.translation: That man, who sings the Praise of the Lord, the treasure of mercy, has the help and support of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਇਹੀ ਭਰੋਸੈ ਗਹੀ ਆਨਿ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak mai ihee bharosai gahee aan saranaaee ||2||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have come to rely on this. I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab mai kahaa karau ree maaee ||
lines.translation: What should I do now, O mother?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਖੋਇਆ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਨਾਹਿ ਕਨੑਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal janam bikhian siu khoiaa simario naahi kanhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have wasted my whole life in sin and corruption; I never remembered the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਜਬ ਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਿਹ ਸੁਧਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaal phaas jab gar mahi melee tih sudh sabh bisaraaee ||
lines.translation: When Death places the noose around my neck, then I lose all my senses.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਯਾ ਸੰਕਟ ਮਹਿ ਕੋ ਅਬ ਹੋਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin yaa sa(n)kat mahi ko ab hot sahaaee ||1||
lines.translation: Now, in this disaster, other than the Name of the Lord, who will be my help and support? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਛਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sa(n)pat apanee kar maanee chhin mahi bhaee paraaee ||
lines.translation: That wealth, which he believes to be his own, in an instant, belongs to another.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਯਹ ਸੋਚ ਰਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak yah soch rahee man har jas kabahoo na gaaee ||2||2||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, this still really bothers my mind - I never sang the Praises of the Lord. ||2||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮੈ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaee mai man ko maan na tiaagio ||
lines.translation: O my mother, I have not renounced the pride of my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਮਦਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਇਓ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa ke mad janam siraaio raam bhajan nahee laagio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have wasted my life intoxicated with Maya; I have not focused myself in meditation on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਡੰਡੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਤਬ ਸੋਵਤ ਤੈ ਜਾਗਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam ko da(n)d pario sir oopar tab sovat tai jaagio ||
lines.translation: When Death's club falls on my head, then I will be wakened from my sleep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਹੋਤ ਅਬ ਕੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਏ ਛੂਟਤ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਭਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa hot ab kai pachhutaae chhootat naahin bhaagio ||1||
lines.translation: But what good will it do to repent at that time? I cannot escape by running away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਜਬ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਨ ਅਨੁਰਾਗਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: ih chi(n)taa upajee ghat mahi jab gur charanan anuraagio ||
lines.translation: When this anxiety arises in the heart, then, one comes to love the Guru's feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਬ ਹੂਆ ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਸ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਗਿਓ ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: suphal janam naanak tab hooaa jau prabh jas mahi paagio ||2||3||
lines.translation: My life becomes fruitful, O Nanak, only when I am absorbed in the Praises of God. ||2||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo asatapadeeaa mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਕਥੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਹਾਰੇ ਮੁਨੀ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed puraan kathe sune haare munee anekaa ||
lines.translation: Reciting and listening to the Vedas and the Puraanas, countless wise men have grown weary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਭੇਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: athasath teerath bahu ghanaa bhram thaake bhekhaa ||
lines.translation: So many in their various religious robes have grown weary, wandering to the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਏਕਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saacho saahib niramalo man maanai ekaa ||1||
lines.translation: The True Lord and Master is immaculate and pure. The mind is satisfied only by the One Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਜਰਾਵਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਚਾਲਣਹਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too ajaraavar amar too sabh chaalanahaaree ||
lines.translation: You are eternal; You do not grow old. All others pass away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਭਾਇ ਲੈ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam rasaain bhaai lai parahar dukh bhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One who lovingly focuses on the Naam, the source of nectar - his pains are taken away. ||1||Pause||
